desktop.cava_missing: cava not found ({path}). Install cava or set its path in the widget settings.
desktop.cava_failed: Could not start cava. Check the log for details.

gallery.hint: Demo signal, current theme colors. Pick a shape in a widget's settings.

settings_page.label: Settings page
settings_page.description: Which group of settings to show. Options that only apply to the selected shape (radial angles, LED segments, text rows...) are listed at the end of every page.

shape.label: Shape
shape.description: How the spectrum is drawn. Radial shapes look best on a square desktop widget.

baseline.label: Baseline
baseline.description: Where linear shapes grow from. Center mirrors them up and down. On a vertical bar, bottom means the left edge.

frequency_layout.label: Frequency layout
frequency_layout.description: Order of frequencies along the shape. Auto uses low → high for linear shapes and bass-centered mirroring for radial ones.

audio_spectrum_bands.label: Resolution (bands)
audio_spectrum_bands.description: Number of bars / points drawn. Mirrored layouts analyse half as many bands and draw each twice.

length.label: Length
length.description: Widget length along the bar, in px (before the bar's scale).

thickness.label: Thickness
thickness.description: Widget size across the bar, in px. Radial shapes use a square of this size.

aspect.label: Canvas aspect ratio
aspect.description: Auto fills the whole widget box at any size. A fixed ratio keeps that proportion and is centered in the box.

canvas_width.label: Canvas width
canvas_width.description: Canvas width in design units when the aspect ratio is Custom.

canvas_height.label: Canvas height
canvas_height.description: Canvas height in design units when the aspect ratio is Custom.

orientation.label: Orientation
orientation.description: Vertical runs the bands top to bottom, for tall boxes along a screen edge. Preset aspect ratios flip to match.

spacing.label: Spacing
spacing.description: Gap between bars, dots or cells (rows for the meter, ring gap for rings).

bar_width.label: Bar width
bar_width.description: Fixed width of each bar. 0 fits the bars to the available length.

roundness.label: Corner roundness (%)
roundness.description: 0 is square, 100 is fully rounded (pill / circle ends).

min_size.label: Minimum size
min_size.description: Length every element keeps at silence, so a quiet baseline stays visible. 0 lets it vanish.

color_mode.label: Color mode
color_mode.description: Theme colors stay in sync with your Noctalia palette.

color_2.label: Color 2
color_2.description: Second gradient stop; also the accent of the bloom center and pulse rings.

use_color_3.label: Use color 3
use_color_3.description: Add a third stop to gradients and alternating colors.

color_3.label: Color 3
color_3.description: Third gradient / alternating color, when Use color 3 is on.

rainbow_speed.label: Rainbow speed (°/s)
rainbow_speed.description: Hue rotation of the Rainbow color mode. 0 keeps it still.

track_opacity.label: Track / unlit opacity
track_opacity.description: Opacity of unlit LED cells, meter segments, ring tracks, the radial base circle and bar tracks. 0 hides them.

bar_tracks.label: Show bar tracks
bar_tracks.description: Draw a faint full-length track behind each bar.

glow.label: Glow
glow.description: Soft glow radius behind bars and dots. Doubles the drawn elements, so keep it modest at high resolutions.

show_peaks.label: Show peaks
show_peaks.description: Caps that hold the recent maximum and then fall.

custom_peak_color.label: Custom peak color
custom_peak_color.description: Off draws peaks in each bar's own color.

peak_color.label: Peak color
peak_color.description: Used when Custom peak color is on.

peak_thickness.label: Peak thickness
peak_thickness.description: Peak settings apply when Show peaks is on.

peak_gravity.label: Peak fall speed
peak_gravity.description: Gravity applied to falling peaks (full heights per second²).

segments.label: Segments
segments.description: LED cells per band (blocks, dot matrix) or per meter row. 1 makes the meter continuous.

segment_gap.label: Segment gap
segment_gap.description: Gap between cells (and between spectrogram rows).

text_rows.label: Minimum text rows
text_rows.description: Lines of characters stacked to draw taller bars. More rows are added automatically to fill the height when the band count makes the characters small.

text_font.label: Text font
text_font.description: Font family for the text shapes. A monospace font keeps columns aligned.

history.label: History rows
history.description: Rows of past spectra kept on screen (capped at about 1400 cells).

ring_count.label: Rings
ring_count.description: Number of concentric rings; the outer ring is the bass.

radial_inner.label: Inner radius (%)
radial_inner.description: Radius of the base circle as a share of the available radius.

radial_arc.label: Arc (°)
radial_arc.description: How much of the circle is used; less than 360 draws a fan centered on the rotation angle.

radial_rotation.label: Rotation (°)
radial_rotation.description: Turns the whole shape; 0 points the start (or the fan center) at 12 o'clock.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Gain applied to the spectrum before drawing.

noise_floor.label: Noise floor
noise_floor.description: Levels below this are treated as silence.

curve.label: Response curve
curve.description: Below 1 lifts quiet parts, above 1 emphasises loud hits.

tilt.label: Treble tilt
tilt.description: Positive boosts highs and cuts bass; negative does the opposite.

spread.label: Neighbour spread
spread.description: Lifts each band toward its neighbours for smoother, rounder shapes (monstercat-style).

attack_ms.label: Rise smoothing (ms)
attack_ms.description: Time constant for rising levels. 0 reacts instantly.

release_ms.label: Fall smoothing (ms)
release_ms.description: Time constant for falling levels. Higher values fall more slowly.

idle_opacity.label: Silent opacity
idle_opacity.description: Opacity to fade to when silent behaviour is Fade out.

idle_delay_ms.label: Silence delay (ms)
idle_delay_ms.description: How long the audio must stay silent before the silent behaviour starts.

max_fps.label: Max frame rate
max_fps.description: Upper limit on redraws per second.

mpris_only.label: Only while media plays
mpris_only.description: Ignore audio unless an MPRIS player is playing (skips notification sounds and calls).

pause_fullscreen.label: Pause while fullscreen
pause_fullscreen.description: Hide and stop drawing while a fullscreen window (a game, a video) covers this output. Needs a compositor Noctalia can watch (Umbriel, niri, Hyprland).

audio_spectrum.label: Capture audio
audio_spectrum.description: Subscribe to Noctalia's PipeWire spectrum. Turning it off leaves the widget idle.

cava_path.label: cava executable
cava_path.description: The desktop widget runs cava for audio. A bare name is looked up in PATH.

audio_source.label: Audio source
audio_source.description: cava source (node / monitor name). Empty uses the default output, so you see what you hear.

cava_noise_reduction.label: cava smoothing
cava_noise_reduction.description: cava's own noise reduction. Higher is smoother but slower.
